key_insight: ClinHallu pinpoints hallucinations in medical MLLM reasoning by separating failures into visual recognition, knowledge recall, and reasoning integration.
clinical_relevance: This benchmark can help developers and clinicians better diagnose and reduce unreliable outputs in multimodal medical AI used for decision support.
method: Built a 7,031-instance benchmark with validated medical examples.
Added structured reasoning traces for three stages: visual recognition, knowledge recall, and reasoning integration.
Used stage-replacement interventions and trace-supervised fine-tuning to test and reduce hallucinations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that ClinHallu includes 7,031 validated instances and evaluates how correcting specific reasoning stages changes final answers.
watch_item: Benchmark results may not fully generalize to real-world clinical workflows, so external validation and careful deployment are still needed.
paper_title: ClinHallu: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Stage-Wise Hallucinations in Medical MLLM Reasoning
